name: NordInvest Property Analyzer
description: Free property investment analysis for Nordic and European real estate. Rental yield, cash flow, ROI, BRRRR, appreciation projection — in under 60 seconds.

actions.description: Analyze whether a specific property in the Nordic or European markets is worth buying as an investment. Accepts either a listing URL or manual inputs.
Extract price, location, size, property type, energy label, and condition summary from a public property listing URL.

url.description: Public listing URL from finn.no, hemnet.se, boligsiden.dk, boliga.dk, rightmove.co.uk, zillow.com, etc.

actions.description: Return per-square-metre sale price, rental price, and annual appreciation for a Nordic city — sourced exclusively from official national statistics agencies (DST EJ55, SCB BO0501, SSB 06035).

location.description: City name (e.g. Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Oslo)

country.description: Two-letter country code (DK, SE, NO). Optional.
